parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  n.*,
  c.id as client_id,
  c.company_name,
  c.plan,
  c.is_active as client_active,
  c.emails_per_month,
  nb.title as branding_title,
  nb.subtitle as branding_subtitle,
  nb.logo_url,
  nb.primary_color,
  nb.secondary_color,
  nb.footer_text
FROM newsletters n
JOIN clients c ON n.client_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN newsletter_branding nb ON nb.newsletter_id = n.id
WHERE c.api_key = '{{ $json.apiKey }}'
  AND n.id = '{{ $json.newsletterId }}'
  AND n.is_active = true
  AND c.is_active = true
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Get Newsletter (API)
nodes.notes: Fetches newsletter config by API key

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  n.*,
  c.id as client_id,
  c.company_name,
  c.plan,
  c.is_active as client_active,
  c.emails_per_month,
  nb.title as branding_title,
  nb.subtitle as branding_subtitle,
  nb.logo_url,
  nb.primary_color,
  nb.secondary_color,
  nb.footer_text
FROM newsletters n
JOIN clients c ON n.client_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN newsletter_branding nb ON nb.newsletter_id = n.id
WHERE n.is_active = true
  AND n.schedule_enabled = true
  AND c.is_active = true
  AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE n.schedule_timezone) = n.schedule_hour
  AND EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE n.schedule_timezone) BETWEEN n.schedule_minute AND n.schedule_minute + 4
  AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE n.schedule_timezone)::int = ANY(n.schedule_days);
